topic: Polyglot Kubernetes AI Stack Architecture & Implementation (k8s-ai-stack)
content: Brighton Kimani designed and deployed a low-footprint, RAM-optimized polyglot AI microservice stack in the ai-stack Kubernetes namespace (github.com/Gachagokimani/kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack). It integrates five decoupled services: (1) llama-server running Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF on CPU (NodePort 30880), (2) SearXNG privacy-first meta-search engine (NodePort 30881), (3) FastAPI Python RAG orchestrator and portfolio UI (NodePort 30882), (4) .NET 8 Minimal API gateway for PDF ingestion, Markdown output sanitization, and dual PVC + PostgreSQL persistence, and (5) Java HTTP indexer synchronizing uploaded offer and proposal PDFs into /shared/kb/proposals_offers.json.

topic: Kubernetes Security, ConfigMaps, Encrypted Secrets & .NET 8 OAuth SSO RBAC
content: To harden the ai-stack cluster for production deployment on OCI Ampere A1 nodes, Brighton implemented centralized ConfigMaps (ai-stack-config), Kubernetes Secrets (ai-stack-secrets) protected with kube-apiserver etcd encryption at rest, and a standalone .NET 8 OAuth 2.0 SSO RBAC microservice (rbac-sso-dotnet). The RBAC service verifies GitHub OAuth identity against ADMIN_ALLOWED_IDS, issues HttpOnly HMAC-SHA256 JWT cookies, acts as a Policy Decision Point (/api/rbac/authorize), and strictly gates the Proposals navbar link, upload bar, and private Proposals Vault.
